item.title: Create Microservice Configuration
item.description: This section describes how to create a microservice configuration. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Spring Cloud extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a project and have the Spring Cloud Microservice Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Spring Cloud Microservice Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Copy Microservice Configuration
item.description: This section describes how to copy a microservice configuration. You can use an existing microservice configuration to create a new one with a different name but identical data. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Spring Cloud extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a project and have the Spring Cloud Microservice Management permission in the project.

item.title: Roll Back Microservice Configuration
item.description: This section describes how to roll back microservice configuration. Each time you edit a microservice configuration, a modification record is generated. You can use these records to roll back the microservice configuration to a historical version. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Spring Cloud extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a project and have the Spring Cloud Microservice Management permission in the project.
